subject: mathematics
concept: Factoring simple expressions by identifying a common factor
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles (reverse area model) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student rearranges tiles from an expanded expression back into a common-factor area-model shape
exercise.pictorial: Student matches an expanded expression to its correctly factored form
exercise.abstract: Student factors a given expression by pulling out the greatest common factor

misconception_flags: pulls out a factor that isn't common to all terms, or misses the greatest common factor

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
